How to explore this prototype

A clickable concept for a student housing app built around short-term (4–6 month) contracts in Provo/Orem. Listings are made up and the "AI" is scripted. Nothing you type is saved; we only count (anonymously) which features people try.

    Tip: everything is clickable. Filters, sorting, swipes, the eligibility chat, posting a listing and the seller inbox all work on sample data in this browser tab.
